content_id: 547 first-key items in readable 608-item packet projection
observed_behavior: 547/608 readable items (89.97%) put the key first; 382/432 items named in objective check lists do so. The three inspected response renderers iterate stored order. A first-position strategy therefore exploits a strong corpus cue. This is one response-design defect, not 547 allegations of wrong linguistic keys. No behavioral learner experiment was run.
expected_behavior: Closed-response performance should depend on the taught distinction, with answer placement offering no systematic shortcut.
evidence: Independent packet-field inventory at this target plus current renderer trace. The producer reports 561/622 including 14 packet-absent items; that larger denominator was NOT independently reproduced.
proposed_correction: Use a reviewed balanced ordering or deterministic presentation permutation while preserving keyed values and persisted attempt identity. Do not silently relabel historical answers or regenerate protected evidence.
acceptance_test: Inventory all 622 raw items and required check placements; measure position bias before and after. Exercise lesson, optional lab and cumulative review after rotation/resume, ensuring displayed order is stable for a saved task and correct/wrong scoring is unchanged. Include an always-first strategy check.

observed_behavior: Unit 1 says it introduces no words and has no model audio or stress-marked example words. Its decoding check matches a printed case pair. Unit 2 repeats five printed-letter checks and delegates handwriting/pronunciation to the book. Current availability code does not supply the required mapped listening/pronunciation/handwriting foundation. This continues the bounded substance of IA004; truthful unavailable states are a positive protection.
expected_behavior: Required book-aligned literacy includes reviewed app decoding, handwriting recognition and licensed audio practice; book self-attestation must remain distinct from demonstrated app checks.
evidence: All Unit 1/2 step bodies and check lists; V2GovernedIdentity practice offers; private Lesson 1 §§1.1-1.5 pp1-10 and Lesson 2 §§2.1-2.11 pp12-21. PDF bytes/hash verified anew.
proposed_correction: Research and admit a bounded licensed foundation with syllable/word/short-phrase decoding, marked stress, handwriting discrimination and correctly mapped model audio. Keep unsupported modalities unavailable until admitted.
acceptance_test: Complete a novice foundation flow offline with multiple distinct decoding/recognition checks, handwriting contrasts, model listening and unscored recording. Verify content, rights, text/audio match and remediation. Do not substitute the unrelated catalog.

observed_behavior: Both independent consolidation items ask for partners in two verb pairs. Neither supplies a request/prohibition context requiring an aspect choice. Correctly naming a partner can pass this declared scope without using the imperative-aspect distinctions that make this lesson more than paradigm recognition.
expected_behavior: The consolidation evidence should include a taught contextual aspect distinction relevant to requests or prohibitions, with bounded claims about what it demonstrates.
evidence: All nine Unit 15 packet items and targeted consolidation teaching; private Lesson 15 §15.3 p174 and §15.11 p178. This is an app teaching/check scope gap, not a claim that an existing Russian key is false.
proposed_correction: Retain pair recall as preparatory practice; research and bind distinct contextual imperative-aspect applications with explanatory repair.
acceptance_test: A learner who knows the two pairs but selects an aspect inconsistent with a fully specified taught request/prohibition context must not demonstrate that contextual objective.

locator: Unit 21 purpose teaching and independent list
observed_behavior: The guided item recognizes the purpose conjunction. The two independent items recognize condition and cause instead. Teaching mentions a same-subject purpose construction, but no independent item in this objective interprets or selects that construction. These keys are not alleged incorrect; they do not demonstrate the named purpose objective.
expected_behavior: At least one distinct independent application should test the taught purpose relation and construction rather than only neighboring conjunction glosses.
evidence: All nine Unit 21 packet items, all purpose teaching/repair; private Lesson 21 §21.7 p261 and §21.8 p262. Full different-subject control construction is additionally outside the inspected app check scope.
proposed_correction: Keep valid conjunction vocabulary; admit a complete taught purpose context and a distinct independent check. Qualify any broader clause-construction claim.
acceptance_test: Test a fully specified purpose relation against condition/cause alternatives. Verify the independent check actually requires the intended relation and has one defensible answer.

evidence: All Unit 22 objectives and half-form items/teaching; private Lesson 22 §§22.5-22.6 pp273-274 and §22.13 p279.

The eleven packet items concentrate on walking/vehicle movement, carrying, setting out, paths and directionality; they do not establish the book-aligned distinction among ways of bringing. An unprefixed carry gloss is not evidence of interpreting a bringing construction.
expected_behavior: Track bringing as an explicit part of the required motion scope, with a bounded independently checked application or an incomplete disposition.
evidence: All Unit 20 packet items and motion teaching; private Lesson 20 §20.5 p248. Raw curriculum bytes unavailable.
proposed_correction: Verify the raw scope before editing; if absent, research a licensed bringing context and its carrying/leading/transport distinction without altering the now-correct directionality contexts.
acceptance_test: Show a taught context whose intended bringing meaning distinguishes the admitted alternatives. Verify one defensible key and complete source binding.

locator: Two same-unit guided/independent exact tuple groups
observed_behavior: Two groups have identical prompt, cue, ordered options and key across a guided item and an item declared independent. Different objective IDs and provenance IDs do not create a new application. Most of the earlier eleven duplicate groups have changed; these two remain. This limits transfer evidence, without making either key linguistically false.
expected_behavior: An independent application should distinguish performance from exact guided-answer replay.
evidence: Independent exact-tuple grouping over 608 current readable items, followed by full-field inspection of all four records.
proposed_correction: Retain the valid guided examples; use a distinct admitted application for the independent task or qualify its role as rehearsal. Do not erase historical attempts.
acceptance_test: Check duplicate identity across objective boundaries within each unit. Verify the replacement tests a taught contrast in a distinct context and retains unique correct and wrong-answer explanations.
